title: Paper menus and shouting
body: Staff carry menus, take orders by hand and walk each one to the kitchen.

title: Level 1, A menu on every table
body: A code on each table opens your full menu with photos and prices.

title: Level 2, One button calls the waiter
body: Guests fill the cart and tap the button below it. The waiter is notified with the table number and comes over.

title: Level 3, The order goes straight in
body: Guests order from the phone. Reception or the kitchen gets it with the table number. It is made and served.
